title: Environment (B1)
note: Extended layer above leaf_nature_a2 (weather and nature). The issue vocabulary: pollution, waste, energy, climate. Discussion fuel for b1_second_conditional. First draft 2026-09-02. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma. E10: Use is use_mode rewrite, 12 underlined paraphrases. F7: ten tiles an earlier pack already owns (pollution, plastic, recycle, cycle, plant, forest, countryside, ocean, temperature from A1/A2 nature, and waste from leaf_money_b1 at path 31) moved to a **You already know** board; the list was refilled with coal, carbon, landfill, shortage, nuclear, packaging, conservation, habitat, endangered and crops. · Pool-checked against everything taught before leaf_environment_b1 — 0 unknown types. · 2026-09-04: nine rewrite items re-cut so replacing the underline reconstructs the answer. · 2026-09-05 B1 loop: sentence texture. 20 of 36 Use sentences were FLAT under check_sentence_texture.py. intro.title: You will use these words in
frames: … is a bigger problem than … · *… je větší problém než …*
… is cheaper than … · *… je levnější než …*
intro.note: This is the discussion fuel for **b1_second_conditional**: *If we used public transport, emissions would fall.* Say the problem, then say what you would do.
intro.note_cz: Tahle slova se hodí k druhému kondicionálu (b1_second_conditional).

sentences.en: Climate change is a bigger problem than most people think.
sentences.cz: Změna klimatu je větší problém, než si většina lidí myslí.
accepts: Climate change is a bigger problem than most people think

sentences.en: Global warming is changing the winters here, although the summers feel the same.
sentences.cz: Globální oteplování mění zdejší zimy, i když léta jsou pořád stejná.
accepts: Global warming is changing the winters here, although the summers feel the same

sentences.en: Every fossil fuel will run out one day, although nobody knows when.
sentences.cz: Každé fosilní palivo jednou dojde, i když nikdo neví kdy.
accepts: Every fossil fuel will run out one day, although nobody knows when

sentences.en: Coal was the cheapest energy for a hundred years.
sentences.cz: Uhlí bylo sto let nejlevnější energií.
accepts: Coal was the cheapest energy for a hundred years

sentences.en: The new law will cut emissions from cars, but the buses stay the same.
sentences.cz: Nový zákon sníží emise z aut, ale autobusů se to netýká.
accepts: The new law will cut emissions from cars, but the buses stay the same

sentences.en: Trains make less carbon than planes.
sentences.cz: Vlaky vyprodukují méně uhlíku než letadla.
accepts: Trains make less carbon than planes

sentences.en: Deforestation is the reason many animals have no home, although the government promised to stop it.
sentences.cz: Odlesňování je důvod, proč mnoho zvířat nemá domov, i když vláda slíbila, že to zastaví.
accepts: Deforestation is the reason many animals have no home, although the government promised to stop it

sentences.en: The drought lasted all summer because it did not rain once.
sentences.cz: Sucho trvalo celé léto, protože ani jednou nezapršelo.
accepts: The drought lasted all summer because it did not rain once

sentences.en: The flood closed the road for a week, but the trains still ran.
sentences.cz: Povodeň zavřela silnici na týden, ale vlaky pořád jezdily.
accepts: The flood closed the road for a week, but the trains still ran

sentences.en: The company put poison in the river for years before the city found out.
sentences.cz: Ta firma léta vypouštěla do řeky jed, než na to město přišlo.
accepts: The company put poison in the river for years before the city found out

sentences.en: Most of our waste still goes to a landfill, although the city built a new centre.
sentences.cz: Většina našeho odpadu pořád končí na skládce, i když město postavilo nové centrum.
accepts: Most of our waste still goes to a landfill, although the city built a new centre

sentences.en: There was a water shortage last summer because it did not rain for two months.
sentences.cz: Loni v létě byl nedostatek vody, protože dva měsíce nepršelo.
accepts: There was a water shortage last summer because it did not rain for two months

sentences.en: Renewable energy is cheaper than it was ten years ago.
sentences.cz: Obnovitelná energie je levnější, než byla před deseti lety.
accepts: Renewable energy is cheaper than it was ten years ago

sentences.en: Solar power works even on a grey day, but it makes less in winter.
sentences.cz: Solární energie funguje i za šedivého dne, ale v zimě jí vyrobí míň.
accepts: Solar power works even on a grey day, but it makes less in winter

sentences.en: They built a wind farm near the village where I grew up.
sentences.cz: U vesnice, kde jsem vyrostl, postavili větrný park.
accepts: They built a wind farm near the village where I grew up

sentences.en: Nuclear energy makes no carbon, but people are afraid of it.
sentences.cz: Jaderná energie nedělá žádný uhlík, ale lidé se jí bojí.
accepts: Nuclear energy makes no carbon, but people are afraid of it

sentences.en: We must save water in summer because the river is very low.
sentences.cz: V létě musíme šetřit vodou, protože je řeka hodně nízko.
accepts: We must save water in summer because the river is very low

sentences.en: A reusable bottle is cheaper than buying a new one every day.
sentences.cz: Opakovaně použitelná lahev je levnější než kupovat každý den novou.
accepts: A reusable bottle is cheaper than buying a new one every day

sentences.en: Organic food is better for the soil, but it costs more.
sentences.cz: Bio potraviny jsou lepší pro půdu, ale stojí víc.
accepts: Organic food is better for the soil, but it costs more

sentences.en: Public transport is cheaper than driving.
sentences.cz: Veřejná doprava je levnější než jezdit autem.
accepts: Public transport is cheaper than driving

sentences.en: An energy-efficient house is warm although the bill is small.
sentences.cz: Energeticky úsporný dům je teplý, i když je účet malý.
accepts: An energy-efficient house is warm although the bill is small

sentences.en: Two hundred people came to clean up the river after the flood.
sentences.cz: Dvě stě lidí přišlo uklidit řeku po povodni.
accepts: Two hundred people came to clean up the river after the flood

sentences.en: There is too much packaging around everything we buy, although the shops promise to change.
sentences.cz: Kolem všeho, co koupíme, je příliš mnoho obalů, i když obchody slibují změnu.
accepts: There is too much packaging around everything we buy, although the shops promise to change

sentences.en: Conservation work in the park is paid for by the city.
sentences.cz: Ochranu přírody v parku platí město.
accepts: Conservation work in the park is paid for by the city

sentences.en: Everybody talks about the environment, but few people change.
sentences.cz: Všichni mluví o životním prostředí, ale málokdo se změní.
accepts: Everybody talks about the environment, but few people change

sentences.en: The wildlife came back when the traffic stopped.
sentences.cz: Zvířata se vrátila, když přestala doprava.
accepts: The wildlife came back when the traffic stopped

sentences.en: The birds lost their habitat when the trees came down.
sentences.cz: Ptáci přišli o své prostředí, když padly stromy.
accepts: The birds lost their habitat when the trees came down

sentences.en: This species lives only in one part of the country where the forest is old.
sentences.cz: Tenhle druh žije jen v jedné části země, kde je starý les.
accepts: This species lives only in one part of the country where the forest is old

sentences.en: The bear is an endangered animal here, although the numbers are rising.
sentences.cz: Medvěd je tady ohrožené zvíře, i když jeho počty rostou.
accepts: The bear is an endangered animal here, although the numbers are rising

sentences.en: Many species are now extinct because people cut down the trees.
sentences.cz: Mnoho druhů už vyhynulo, protože lidé pokáceli stromy.
accepts: Many species are now extinct because people cut down the trees

sentences.en: The glacier in the photograph is much smaller than it was in 1990.
sentences.cz: Ledovec na té fotografii je mnohem menší, než byl v roce 1990.
accepts: The glacier in the photograph is much smaller than it was in 1990

sentences.en: The soil here is too dry for anything but grass.
sentences.cz: Půda je tu moc suchá na cokoli kromě trávy.
accepts: The soil here is too dry for anything but grass

sentences.en: The gases stay in the atmosphere for a hundred years, although the cars are cleaner now.
sentences.cz: Ty plyny zůstávají v atmosféře sto let, i když jsou auta teď čistší.
accepts: The gases stay in the atmosphere for a hundred years, although the cars are cleaner now

sentences.en: A sustainable farm uses less water, although the food costs more.
sentences.cz: Udržitelná farma spotřebuje méně vody, i když jídlo stojí víc.
accepts: A sustainable farm uses less water, although the food costs more

sentences.en: The lake is natural, not made by people.
sentences.cz: To jezero je přírodní, ne vytvořené lidmi.
accepts: The lake is natural, not made by people

sentences.en: The crops failed because it did not rain for three months.
sentences.cz: Úroda selhala, protože tři měsíce nepršelo.
accepts: The crops failed because it did not rain for three months

use_hint: Rewrite the sentence. Replace the underlined words.
